gate.source: memu.db memory_items, rows with correction markers + conf>=0.75
gate.signal_1: BGE-M3 embedding cosine similarity (port 8002, 1024d) query vs row text
gate.signal_2: token overlap re-rank (CJK bigram, same tokenizer logic as _memory_search)
gate.signal_3: correction-marker rows (你刚才答错了 etc.) weighted x2
gate.signal_4: s1_neural_report top neuron types vote (already computed in pipeline before 4759)
gate.threshold: gate passes only if (embedding_sim >= 0.60 AND corrected_row_top1) OR (embedding_sim >= 0.75 without marker)
gate.fail_safe: any exception -> return None -> original LLM path unchanged

direct_answer_format: correction row content verbatim + provenance note
audit: log["neural_direct"] = {fired, sim, row_id, took_ms} -> visible in /contemplate-job response
rollout_flag: EGO_NEURAL_DIRECT=0 env kills it instantly (default on, set 0 to disable)
